scope: Make DRW_Camera DWG encoding transactional across common body and handle output, including its VIEW hard-pointer tail, and prove allocation-failure rollback and same-object retry.

changes: Run common entity encoding, entity handles, the VIEW hard pointer, and oType mutation through encodeEntityDwgTransaction.
Preserve existing AC1015+ version admission and the hard-pointer role and order.
implementation.failureBehavior: Injected allocation failure preserves caller stream bytes and bit positions and restores oType; retrying the same object with the same buffers reproduces clean output.

validation.allocationSweep: PASS: 3,914 allocation offsets across HATCH, MPOLYGON, MLEADER, ARCALIGNEDTEXT, LIGHT, SECTIONOBJECT, GEOPOSITIONMARKER, and CAMERA; 185 entity/version/stream-layout profiles

coverage: Generated AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 profiles use five body/string/handle alias layouts each.
Each profile includes a nonzero VIEW hard-pointer reference.
Each injected allocation failure checks stream rollback and oType restoration, then retries the same object into the same seeded buffers and compares exact output with clean encoding.
limitations: This proves generated transaction/failure behavior only, not CAMERA wire semantics, VIEW graph closure, native camera behavior, physical-source behavior, or output qualification.
No DWG or DXF drawing fixture was added.
